dedupe_keys.name: hamilton harbour acoustic doppler current profiler data

description: Hamilton Harbour Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler data is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler(ADCP) data was collected during the summer months of 2017 in the Randle Reef area of Hamilton Harbor. The data is used to validate a three dimensional MIKE3-FM hydrodynamic and mud transport modeling system. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Profileur de Courant Acoustique Doppler, Modélisation Hydrodynamique, Concentration de particules en suspension, Plan d’Action des Grands Lacs (PAGL), Port de Hamilton. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, TXT. The portal shows 2021-07-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
